criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frame 5 nearly passes the showstopper test. Frame 1's turbine is finished but thin. Three frames lean on a primitive or a default: frame 4's radiator bank with floating bushings and hairline far fence, frame 2's flat caliche card with a pin shadow longer than the square, frame 8's chain tangle with both leaves cropped. Frame 3's bay plates don't register to the hall's louvres. Frame 9 has sliced turret windows and several lit windows. Frame 7 reads closer to a corrugated chart than land.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world and one light, the key low from the left on every spatial frame, the accent meaning what is planned, a dark value held. Frame 2 sits outside. The fence motif is faint on 1 and 6.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Charged: slide 8's majority ownership sat outside c8's stored quote; no Applied Digital release or SEC filing used; the cover's past tense paraphrases c10, not cited on slide 1; slide 5's headline drops up to; the caption's it after Briscoe Wind; slide 9's An abatement comes first reads as if one will be granted.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and timing land. The deciding body is never named and the caption closes on a question. Nothing says what an abatement means for the county's tax base.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The turn sits at 5 and the close lands on the county condition. Frame 7 repeats frame 4's geometry from above.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on house rules. Attribution heavy, Drawn to illustrate as boilerplate, the Caprock never reaches the copy.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The turbine cover and tower-section unit are new. lastLight for the fourth deck in five, survey stakes, the shut gate and squares drawn to area recur.

one_sentence_fix: Make slide 8's ChronoScale is majority owned by Applied rest on a stored quote that says it, then rebuild frame 4's substation and frame 2's card-flat map.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A primitive box with plate fins and floating bushings that doesn't read as a substation, the fence across the road hairlines.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Use the kit substation yard and shoot through the chain link from 15 to 20 m back so the lit pasture fence sits mid-frame with three posts readable.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The plateau reads as a flat card and the pin's shadow dwarfs the square.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swap the pin for a flush disc, model the Caprock escarpment as a lit cliff edge, give the neighbours red bed albedo and lit groove walls.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The chain is a tangle and both leaves run off the edges, so 51/49 can't be read.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back until both hinge posts and leaf ends show, one chain wrapped twice through the latch hanging to the padlock.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The orange bay plates don't register to the kit hall's louvre openings and muddle the 10 bay count.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drive the emissive onto the kit's own louvres, exactly ten openings, the tenth lit to 0.8 of its height.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The near turbine measures the columns and the casts are a short band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push the turbine deeper as backdrop and raise the lit pool so the long casts run across the straw.
